name: Neusiedlersee

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Austrian quality wine from approved grape varieties, tested by the state before sale. Prädikatswein and DAC wines sit within it.
Districtus Austriae Controllatus, Austria's rules for regionally typical wines. The wine must show the typical character of its area.

blurb.text: A wine area in Burgenland, Austria, where Zweigelt is the most planted grape at 24 percent, ahead of Grüner Veltliner, Welschriesling and Blaufränkisch. Its DAC covers dry reds based on Zweigelt and, since 2020, sweet wines.
